name: evidence_enough
question: Do the documents read so far hold enough to answer the sub-question?
source: R1 topic 4 seed set (2026-10-10): 16 (sub-question, documents) cases. Pairs that differ only in whether the deciding fact is stated, multi-part questions with one part missing, on-topic pages without the asked fact, an injected instruction, and a Finglish subset. 'enough' for a not_enough case counts as unsafe: it ends the search with a thin report. Documents are one string: each is its URL on the first line and its text after it, separated by a line of ---.
